status_definitions.ACTIVE: Shipped in the published target release AND retained installed evidence exists for the exact host×target×profile pair. Requires non-empty evidence.
status_definitions.DEV: Implemented and demonstrated by an installed local-Mac slice that is not release certified. Requires non-empty evidence.
status_definitions.PLANNED: Committed direction with no negotiation path. Requires empty negotiated_by, rejected_by and evidence.
status_definitions.NA: Explicitly rejected by validation as an unsupported pairing or declaration. Requires non-empty rejected_by.

backends.note: MachineBackend::Other(String) is an escape hatch, not a named backend; it is intentionally absent from wire_names.

macos-arm64.note: Only Apple-silicon macOS hosts resolve Machines (crates/vz-runtimed/src/machine_target_resolver.rs:569-573).

macos-x86_64.note: Intel Macs are not a supported host.

linux.note: Universal target. Only aarch64 Linux targets resolve today (crates/vz-runtimed/src/machine_target_resolver.rs:581-586).

evidence_notes: .artifacts/ is gitignored; evidence entries carry run_id, result_sha256 and checksums_sha256 so they can be re-verified from a retained copy without relying on the path.
Every retained Docker-lane result.json reports aggregate_release_certified=false, docker_parity_certified=false and release_scenarios_passed=[]; the passing outcomes are DEV slices only.
planning/developer-environments/macos-local-setup-evidence.json reports passed=false (INSTALLED_LOCAL_MACOS_SETUP_IN_PROGRESS) and is therefore not cited as evidence.

pairs.note: Installed local-Mac slices pass; no published 0.4 release and release_scenarios_passed is empty in every retained result, so nothing here is ACTIVE.

posix_pty.note: Linux readiness measures only posix_exec plus Docker capabilities; terminal exec requires posix_pty (crates/vz-runtimed/src/machine_exec.rs:364-377) so `vz exec --tty` against a Linux Machine is not negotiable today. Docker container TTY in the lifecycle lane goes through the Machine's private Engine, not Machine PTY exec.
